summary: Migrated yard/quayline.py to Quayline v4 (paths, fields, statuses incl. rescheduled/expired mapping, UTC timestamps, ISO dates, PATCH cancel instead of the deprecated endpoint, new error body, 201 on create) keeping the public API and v3 return values. ApiError.code passes through the v4 body code (e.g. slot_conflict, not the old slot_taken).
